fundamentalRule: Approved screens are Visual Contracts, not static production data.

sampleContentPolicy.rule: Example content inside an approved mockup is sample content only unless an element is explicitly classified STATIC_VISUAL.
examplesThatAreNeverProductionTruthByThe: example plant photographs used to illustrate a result
sampleContentPolicy.failureRule: If runtime data is unavailable, do not silently retain sample content and present it as user truth.

classifications.STATIC_VISUAL: Approved pixels/artwork/copy whose meaning is intentionally fixed and not user/business data.
classifications.DYNAMIC_TEXT: Text bound to authoritative runtime records.
classifications.DYNAMIC_IMAGE: Image bound to an exact authoritative entity/state.
classifications.DYNAMIC_STATE: Selection, progress, health/task/filter/nav state or other runtime state.
classifications.DERIVED_VALUE: Value calculated from authoritative records/engines rather than stored as independent truth.
classifications.ACTION: Visible control that invokes navigation or an allowed command.

globalInvariants: My Plants Plant identity is garden_plants.id. All display fields on a Plant card belong to that exact Plant Instance.
Plant Detail MUST use the same garden_plants.id as the My Plants card that opened it.
Personal Plant Photo is garden_media selected by garden_plants.cover_media_id for the same garden_plants.id.
System-image fallback MUST be the canonical visual for the same profile_slug. Never substitute another species image and never guess an image.
Schedule, Upcoming, Calendar, Need your attention, and Notifications are views of the same garden_tasks records, not copies.
Plant History and Garden Journal are scopes over the same garden_events records, not duplicate history stores.
Garden Photo is Garden Profile state and is separate from Plant Photo. Local/demo images are never production source of truth.
Plant Identification approved screenshots define layout. Actual identity, image, confidence, profile and care content bind to the real identification result plus canonical catalog identity.
Climate/Suitability requires trusted Garden location + Area context + canonical catalog climate traits + the approved climate/suitability engine. Decorative hardcoded scores are forbidden.
Missing data must stay missing/unknown or block the dependent action. Silent inference and sample-content fallback are forbidden.

requiredProof: Same approved My Plants composition is used for both datasets.
Visible name changes according to garden_plants for each fixture.
Visible canonical/system image changes according to the exact profile_slug for each fixture.
Visible plant-bound data changes according to the exact garden_plants.id.
No layout, artwork, typography, spacing or proportions are altered to make either fixture fit.
myPlantsTwoFixtureProofGate.failCondition: If the same mockup plant identity/image remains visible for both fixture datasets where a plant-bound dynamic element should differ, FAIL as hardcoded content.

crossScreenIdentityContracts.plantInstance: My Plants and all Plant Detail tabs must carry the same exact garden_plants.id; name/species matching is forbidden.
crossScreenIdentityContracts.tasks: Schedule / Upcoming / Calendar / Notifications must render the same garden_tasks.id identities for overlapping scope.
crossScreenIdentityContracts.history: Plant History / Garden Journal must render the same garden_events.id identities for overlapping scope.
crossScreenIdentityContracts.images: Personal Plant image stays exact-instance scoped; canonical system fallback stays exact-profile_slug scoped.
crossScreenIdentityContracts.gardenPhoto: Garden Photo belongs to Garden Profile; Plant Photo belongs to garden_plants.id. They are never interchangeable.

runtimeProofPolicy.myPlantsProofRequired: Two-fixture test: Monstera deliciosa plus a second different species. Same locked UI must change plant-bound name/image/data according to DB. Same mockup plant across both datasets is FAIL.

apiMinimizationGovernance.rule: API minimization is an architecture invariant, not a future optimization.

canonicalFirst.rule: Every read starts with CRUVIT canonical/local persisted data. An external provider may be called only when the required datum is missing, expired under an explicit freshness policy, or the user initiated a new action that truly requires the provider.

uiNeverCallsProvidersDirectly.rule: No Screen or Component may call Anthropic, weather APIs, botanical APIs, image-generation providers, supplier APIs, or any other external provider directly.
uiNeverCallsProvidersDirectly.requiredFlow: UI -> CRUVIT domain/data layer -> provider-decision gate -> external provider only if required

fetchOnceReuseManyExplicitInvalidation.rule: Already-loaded Garden snapshot and canonical/catalog data are reused across screens while valid.
fetchOnceReuseManyExplicitInvalidation.mutationRule: After a successful mutation, perform targeted invalidation/hydration for affected identities only; do not reload the entire system.
fetchOnceReuseManyExplicitInvalidation.forbidden: blind full-app reload after local mutation

zeroExternalCallNavigationTargets.note: Internal bounded Supabase reads may still occur where no valid local snapshot exists; this target concerns external providers.

newUserInitiatedImage.additionalCallAllowedOnlyWhen: User explicitly requests another attempt or a separately-approved recovery policy requires it.

plantIdentification.afterCanonicalResolution: Persist/reuse the canonical result; reopening or reusing that result must not call the identification provider again while valid.
plantIdentification.forbidden: automatic repeated provider retries in the normal path

images.personalImageSource: garden_media for the exact garden_plants.id / cover_media_id
images.systemFallbackSource: Canonical Production visual for the same profile_slug
forbiddenFallbacks: provider lookup merely because a screen opened

requestDeduplication.rule: Identical requests already in flight must be coalesced and reused rather than sent again concurrently.

provenanceFreshness.rule: Externally acquired information must be persisted with enough provenance to decide whether reuse is safe.
provenanceFreshness.refreshRule: Refresh only when policy says the persisted value is stale, invalid, missing, or the user explicitly requests a new acquisition.

internalDatabaseCalls.rule: Supabase reads/writes must also be bounded and batched.
forbidden: N+1 query per plant/card when a garden snapshot or joined/batched query can satisfy the screen
one independent query per visible card solely because the UI renders multiple cards
unbounded full-system reload after a targeted mutation
preferred: reuse of valid loaded snapshot across screens

acceptanceMetrics.rule: A meaningful E2E is not considered fully characterized until these counters are reported.
